cases.question: 전체 주문 건수
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "주문수" FROM "TB_ORDER";

cases.question: 지난달 매출
cases.expected_sql: SELECT SUM("TOTAL_AMT") AS "매출" FROM "TB_ORDER" WHERE "ORDER_STATUS" != '99' AND "ORDER_DTM" >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND "ORDER_DTM" < DATE '2026-10-01';

cases.question: 9월 카드 결제 매출
cases.expected_sql: SELECT SUM("TOTAL_AMT") AS "매출" FROM "TB_ORDER" WHERE "ORDER_STATUS" != '99' AND "ORDER_DTM" >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND "ORDER_DTM" < DATE '2026-10-01' AND "PAY_METHOD" = 'CARD';

cases.question: 결제수단별 매출
cases.expected_sql: SELECT "PAY_METHOD", SUM("TOTAL_AMT") AS "매출" FROM "TB_ORDER" WHERE "ORDER_STATUS" != '99' GROUP BY "PAY_METHOD";

cases.question: 결제수단별 매출 높은 순
cases.expected_sql: SELECT "PAY_METHOD", SUM("TOTAL_AMT") AS "매출" FROM "TB_ORDER" WHERE "ORDER_STATUS" != '99' GROUP BY "PAY_METHOD" ORDER BY "매출" DESC NULLS LAST;

cases.question: 올해 월별 주문 수
cases.expected_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', "ORDER_DTM") AS "ORDER_DTM_month", COUNT(*) AS "주문수" FROM "TB_ORDER" WHERE "ORDER_DTM" >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND "ORDER_DTM" < DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', "ORDER_DTM") ORDER BY "ORDER_DTM_month" ASC;

cases.question: 최근 주문 10건
cases.expected_sql: SELECT "ORDER_ID", "MEMBER_ID", "ORDER_DTM", "TOTAL_AMT" FROM "TB_ORDER" ORDER BY "ORDER_DTM" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

cases.question: 매출 상위 5명 회원
cases.expected_sql: SELECT "MEMBER_ID", SUM("TOTAL_AMT") AS "매출" FROM "TB_ORDER" WHERE "ORDER_STATUS" != '99' GROUP BY "MEMBER_ID" ORDER BY "매출" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5;

cases.question: m001 회원의 주문상세
cases.expected_sql: SELECT "TB_ORDER"."ORDER_ID", "TB_ORDER"."ORDER_DTM", "TB_ORDER_ITEM"."PRODUCT_ID", "TB_ORDER_ITEM"."QTY" FROM "TB_ORDER" INNER JOIN "TB_ORDER_ITEM" ON "TB_ORDER"."ORDER_ID" = "TB_ORDER_ITEM"."ORDER_ID" WHERE "TB_ORDER"."MEMBER_ID" = 'm001';

cases.question: m001 회원의 7월 주문상세
cases.expected_sql: SELECT "TB_ORDER"."ORDER_ID", "TB_ORDER"."ORDER_DTM", "TB_ORDER_ITEM"."PRODUCT_ID", "TB_ORDER_ITEM"."QTY" FROM "TB_ORDER" INNER JOIN "TB_ORDER_ITEM" ON "TB_ORDER"."ORDER_ID" = "TB_ORDER_ITEM"."ORDER_ID" WHERE "TB_ORDER"."MEMBER_ID" = 'm001' AND "TB_ORDER"."ORDER_DTM" >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND "TB_ORDER"."ORDER_DTM" < DATE '2026-08-01';

cases.question: 배송완료된 주문 수
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "주문수" FROM "TB_ORDER" WHERE "ORDER_STATUS" = '03';

cases.question: 취소되지 않은 주문 목록
cases.expected_sql: SELECT "ORDER_ID", "ORDER_STATUS" FROM "TB_ORDER" WHERE "ORDER_STATUS" != '99';

cases.question: 결제완료이거나 배송완료인 주문 수
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "주문수" FROM "TB_ORDER" WHERE "ORDER_STATUS" IN ('02', '03');

cases.question: 취소율
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN "ORDER_STATUS" = '99' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "취소율" FROM "TB_ORDER";

cases.question: 9월 결제수단별 취소율
cases.expected_sql: SELECT "PAY_METHOD", COUNT(CASE WHEN "ORDER_STATUS" = '99' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "취소율" FROM "TB_ORDER" WHERE "ORDER_DTM" >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND "ORDER_DTM" < DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY "PAY_METHOD";

cases.question: 이번달과 지난달 주문 수 비교
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN "ORDER_DTM" >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND "ORDER_DTM" < DATE '2026-11-01' THEN 1 END) AS "주문수_이번달", COUNT(CASE WHEN "ORDER_DTM" >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND "ORDER_DTM" < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN 1 END) AS "주문수_지난달", (COUNT(CASE WHEN "ORDER_DTM" >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND "ORDER_DTM" < DATE '2026-11-01' THEN 1 END) - COUNT(CASE WHEN "ORDER_DTM" >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND "ORDER_DTM" < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN 1 END)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN "ORDER_DTM" >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND "ORDER_DTM" < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN 1 END), 0) AS "주문수_증감률" FROM "TB_ORDER" WHERE "ORDER_DTM" >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND "ORDER_DTM" < DATE '2026-11-01';

cases.question: 이번달과 지난달 매출 비교
cases.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "ORDER_DTM" >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND "ORDER_DTM" < DATE '2026-11-01' THEN "TOTAL_AMT" END) AS "매출_이번달", SUM(CASE WHEN "ORDER_DTM" >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND "ORDER_DTM" < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN "TOTAL_AMT" END) AS "매출_지난달", (SUM(CASE WHEN "ORDER_DTM" >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND "ORDER_DTM" < DATE '2026-11-01' THEN "TOTAL_AMT" END) - SUM(CASE WHEN "ORDER_DTM" >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND "ORDER_DTM" < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN "TOTAL_AMT" END)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "ORDER_DTM" >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND "ORDER_DTM" < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN "TOTAL_AMT" END), 0) AS "매출_증감률" FROM "TB_ORDER" WHERE "ORDER_STATUS" != '99' AND "ORDER_DTM" >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND "ORDER_DTM" < DATE '2026-11-01';

cases.question: VIP 회원 수
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count_*" FROM "TB_MEMBER" WHERE "GRADE_CD" = 'G3';

cases.question: 등급별 회원 수
cases.expected_sql: SELECT "GRADE_CD", COUNT(*) AS "회원수" FROM "TB_MEMBER" GROUP BY "GRADE_CD";

cases.question: 이름에 김이 들어가는 회원
cases.expected_sql: SELECT "MEMBER_ID", "MEMBER_NM" FROM "TB_MEMBER" WHERE "MEMBER_NM" LIKE '%김%' ESCAPE '!';

cases.question: 가입일이 없는 회원
cases.expected_sql: SELECT "MEMBER_ID", "MEMBER_NM" FROM "TB_MEMBER" WHERE "JOIN_DT" IS NULL;

cases.question: 올해 가입한 회원 수
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count_*" FROM "TB_MEMBER" WHERE "JOIN_DT" >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND "JOIN_DT" <= DATE '2026-12-31';

cases.question: 주문한 적 있는 회원 수
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "MEMBER_ID") AS "구매회원수" FROM "TB_ORDER";

cases.question: 주문이 3건 이상인 회원
cases.expected_sql: SELECT "MEMBER_ID", COUNT(*) AS "주문수" FROM "TB_ORDER" GROUP BY "MEMBER_ID" HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3;

cases.question: 주문 금액 합계가 100만원 넘는 회원
cases.expected_sql: SELECT "MEMBER_ID", SUM("TOTAL_AMT") AS "매출" FROM "TB_ORDER" WHERE "ORDER_STATUS" != '99' GROUP BY "MEMBER_ID" HAVING SUM("TOTAL_AMT") > 1000000;

cases.question: 주문 금액 평균
cases.expected_sql: SELECT AVG("TOTAL_AMT") AS "avg_TOTAL_AMT" FROM "TB_ORDER";

cases.question: 가장 큰 주문 금액
cases.expected_sql: SELECT MAX("TOTAL_AMT") AS "max_TOTAL_AMT" FROM "TB_ORDER";

cases.question: 결제수단 종류
cases.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT "PAY_METHOD" FROM "TB_ORDER";

cases.question: VIP 회원의 주문 수
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count_*" FROM "TB_ORDER" INNER JOIN "TB_MEMBER" ON "TB_ORDER"."MEMBER_ID" = "TB_MEMBER"."MEMBER_ID" WHERE "TB_MEMBER"."GRADE_CD" = 'G3';

cases.question: 카테고리별 판매 수량
cases.expected_sql: SELECT "TB_PRODUCT"."CATEGORY_CD", SUM("TB_ORDER_ITEM"."QTY") AS "판매수량" FROM "TB_ORDER_ITEM" INNER JOIN "TB_PRODUCT" ON "TB_ORDER_ITEM"."PRODUCT_ID" = "TB_PRODUCT"."PRODUCT_ID" GROUP BY "TB_PRODUCT"."CATEGORY_CD" ORDER BY "판매수량" DESC NULLS LAST;

cases.question: 가장 많이 팔린 상품 3개
cases.expected_sql: SELECT "TB_PRODUCT"."PRODUCT_NM", SUM("TB_ORDER_ITEM"."QTY") AS "판매수량" FROM "TB_ORDER_ITEM" INNER JOIN "TB_PRODUCT" ON "TB_ORDER_ITEM"."PRODUCT_ID" = "TB_PRODUCT"."PRODUCT_ID" GROUP BY "TB_PRODUCT"."PRODUCT_NM" ORDER BY "판매수량" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3;

cases.question: 등급별 주문 금액 합계
cases.expected_sql: SELECT "TB_MEMBER"."GRADE_CD", SUM("TB_ORDER"."TOTAL_AMT") AS "주문금액" FROM "TB_ORDER" INNER JOIN "TB_MEMBER" ON "TB_ORDER"."MEMBER_ID" = "TB_MEMBER"."MEMBER_ID" GROUP BY "TB_MEMBER"."GRADE_CD";

cases.question: 카드나 계좌이체로 10만원 넘게 결제한 주문
cases.expected_sql: SELECT "ORDER_ID", "PAY_METHOD", "TOTAL_AMT" FROM "TB_ORDER" WHERE "PAY_METHOD" IN ('CARD', 'BANK') AND "TOTAL_AMT" > 100000;

cases.question: 카드 결제이거나 금액이 50만원 이상인 주문 수
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "주문수" FROM "TB_ORDER" WHERE ("PAY_METHOD" = 'CARD' OR "TOTAL_AMT" >= 500000);

cases.question: 주간 주문 추이 (9월)
cases.expected_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', "ORDER_DTM") AS "ORDER_DTM_week", COUNT(*) AS "주문수" FROM "TB_ORDER" WHERE "ORDER_DTM" >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND "ORDER_DTM" < DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', "ORDER_DTM") ORDER BY "ORDER_DTM_week" ASC;

cases.question: 분기별 매출
cases.expected_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', "ORDER_DTM") AS "ORDER_DTM_quarter", SUM("TOTAL_AMT") AS "매출" FROM "TB_ORDER" WHERE "ORDER_STATUS" != '99' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('quarter', "ORDER_DTM");
